study: Phase 2 - HCC MHC-II candidate-selection decision analysis
status: post-pilot method lock; descriptive/exploratory; NOT prospective preregistration or model validation
primary_unit: one WT/MUT mutation-spanning peptide window x one HLA; overlapping windows not independent
strategy_A: Sort lowest mutant BA percentile rank; tie-break lowest mutant EL percentile rank, then candidate_id
strategy_B: Prioritise positive WT-minus-MUT BA delta; within sign class sort lowest mutant BA rank; then largest BA delta; then candidate_id. A negative-delta candidate can enter only after all positive-delta candidates.
strategy_C: Deterministic round-robin without replacement across (1) BA/EL mutation-shift direction conflict, (2) predicted core-offset-change cases, (3) cross-HLA BA sensitivity. Then a fixed EL-rank fallback. C is experimental-question selection, NOT binding quality or vaccine suitability.
C1_within_queue: Opposite nonzero BA and EL delta signs; greatest |deltaBA-deltaEL|, then lowest min(mutant BA, mutant EL), then candidate_id
C2_within_queue: Predicted core offset changed; mutation inside predicted MUT core first, then lowest mutant BA rank, then greatest |deltaBA-deltaEL|, then candidate_id
C3_within_queue: All rows considered for HLA sensitivity; opposite BA-delta signs across the two HLA first, then largest absolute difference in mutant BA rank across HLA, then lowest mutant BA rank, then candidate_id
C_fallback: Remaining rows sorted by lowest mutant EL rank, then candidate_id
hypothesis_safety: No experimental binding, presentation or CD4 outcomes used in ranking. No claims of immunogenicity, neoantigen validation, strategy superiority or model performance.
sensitivity: Report top-K grouping by gene/HLA, unique predicted MUT cores and core-collapsed top-10 diversity; do not treat overlapping windows as biological replicates.
